design.disable_mapping_conflict: A plugin disabled by enabledPlugins in registered roots but still ELIGIBLE from an unregistered extra plugin directory is DISABLE_MISMATCH (P1, FAIL). skillOverrides disables cover every root by construction, so they cannot produce this conflict.
design.layering: Full adapter layers on top of the frozen T003 PoC (claude-poc.ts, NOT modified) + T005 discovery/manifest + T006 kernel (src/resolver). The S0 gate calls the PoC directly and is untouched.
design.marketplaces: extraKnownMarketplaces directory entries and the default <home>/.claude/plugins directory are enumerated as PLUGIN roots (<marketplace>/<plugin>/skills when present, else <marketplace>/<plugin>). A declared marketplace that is missing/unreadable, or a git-source marketplace (unfetchable offline), is SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED for PLUGIN (INCOMPLETE), never silently ignored.

design.namespace_rule: Plugin skills carry the namespace in their logical name (<plugin>:<name>) and are never merged with bare local skills of the same base name; the adapter records observed bare-vs-namespaced pairs in diagnostics.namespacePairs.
design.policy: Owned by the T006 kernel (ADR-005/ADR-006 unchanged): policy passed through, effective set = ELIGIBLE only; DISCOVERED never leaks; UNKNOWN never leaks (fails closed as INCOMPLETE). A forbidden bare name never matches a namespaced instance.
design.settings_rule_adr009: A settings layer file that is present but unreadable, invalid JSON, or invalid in shape makes that layer's effect unknowable: INCOMPLETE with an unknown scope named after the layer (MANAGED_SETTINGS / USER_SETTINGS / PROJECT_SETTINGS / LOCAL_SETTINGS). A missing layer file is not an error. A USER-layer disable of a skill the PROJECT layer would otherwise load is applied deterministically (DISABLED) and recorded in diagnostics.overriddenByUser.
design.settings_rule_adr010: The adapter reads the documented enabledPlugins map ("plugin@marketplace": boolean, false disables) and skillOverrides (name -> "off") from settings layers. disabledPlugins is NOT a documented Claude Code key and is not read. Only the managed layer's strictKnownMarketplaces is honoured; unregistered extra plugin directories are then DISCOVERED (host refuses them), never ELIGIBLE.
design.trust_rule: When trusted is false, settings-derived ADD_DIR roots (additionalDirectories) and marketplace roots do not load: their instances are DISCOVERED. Explicit --plugin-dir style extra directories and caller-provided roots are not trust-gated.

known_limitations: disableSideloadFlags (managed setting that can refuse --plugin-dir) is recorded in claude-rules.json as known-but-not-enforced; the adapter does not enforce it yet.
prependPlugins / appendPlugins (plugin load order) and pluginConfigs are not scope questions and are not enforced.
The adapter does not parse any undocumented Claude storage; account-synced skills without a host snapshot are INCOMPLETE via the PoC, as in S0.
A marketplace plugin whose skills/ directory and plugin directory both exist is read from skills/ only; a plugin with skills split across both layouts is not a layout the adapter supports.
The adapter has no CLI entry yet — T009 wires auditClaude into the CLI and must load the profile policy and pass it through (ADR-005), or policy findings will be silently absent.
